description: Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird has joined 19 other state attorneys general in asking the federal government to crack down on counterfeit weight-loss drugs made with ingredients from Chinese warehouses linked to fentanyl production. The coalition sent a letter to Secretary of State Marco Rubio raising concerns about knock-off GLP-1 drugs.
